items.message: The `--registered` test asserts `mine.exit_code == 0` but never asserts what `show-workflow --registered` prints when the lifecycle module is NOT loaded — the negative path (nothing registered) goes untested.

`test_the_id_discovery_is_not_vacuous` asserts exact sets of workflow ids for `implement` and `fix`, which is good, but `_workflow_function` is only tested for reachability (callable), not that it returns the right function.

`_workflow_ids` parses `register()`'s source with a regex that requires the call to be on a single line (`workflow(id="...")(...)`). A `ruff format` run that wraps arguments across lines would silently return an empty set. `test_the_id_discovery_is_not_vacuous` covers the happy path but no test asserts behaviour when the regex matches nothing — which is the quiet failure mode the test's own docstring describes.
